children: Werner Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: WERN), a premier transportation and logistics provider, proudly joins the industry in celebrating National Truck Driver Appreciation Week, September 13–19, 2026. This year's celebration coincides with a major milestone for the company: 70 years in business. Founded in 1956 by a driver with just one truck, Werner’s driver-first legacy remains the foundation of its ongoing success.

“National Truck Driver Appreciation Week is a time to recognize the incredible men and women who keep our country moving,” said Werner’s Chairman and CEO, Derek Leathers. “Truck drivers take on one of the most critical and demanding jobs in our economy. Their dedication to safety, service and reliability inspires us every day, and we are proud to honor their contributions.”

This week and next, Werner will host Driver Appreciation Week events across its extensive operational network, bringing celebrations directly to team members across Werner, Baylor and FirstFleet locations nationwide. These events bring together drivers, maintenance technicians, office associates and customers to show gratitude and celebrate team achievements, with members of Werner’s executive leadership team attending in person to engage in direct Q&A sessions.

Werner continues to invest in long-term driver success, with 60 percent of its driver workforce with one year or more of company experience. To support ongoing professional growth, Werner offers clear career pathing options designed to empower drivers at every stage of their journey—from new entrants to seasoned professionals seeking specialized routes or leadership roles.

“Our drivers are the backbone of Werner, and we are committed to providing them with the support, tools and programs they need to succeed,” said Werner’s President and Chief Legal Officer, Nathan Meisgeier. “From industry-leading safety initiatives to innovative technology and a comprehensive driver experience, we strive to empower them on and off the road every day. Driver Appreciation Week is our opportunity to celebrate their impact and thank them for everything they do to keep America moving.”
For more information about Werner and its dedication to drivers and customers, visit

Werner Enterprises, Inc. ("Werner") delivers superior truckload transportation and logistics services to customers across the United States, Mexico and Canada. With Werner® 2025 revenues of nearly $3.0 billion, a modern truck and trailer fleet, more than 14,500 talented associates and our innovative Werner EDGE® technology, we are an essential solutions provider for customers who value the integrity of their supply chain and require safe and exceptional on-time service. In January 2026, Werner acquired FirstEnterprises, Inc. ("FirstFleet"), which generated more than $600 million in unaudited 2025 revenues. Werner provides Dedicated and One-Way Truckload services as well as Logistics services that include truckload brokerage, freight management, intermodal and final mile. Werner embraces inclusion as a core value and manages key risks and opportunities through a balanced sustainability strategy.
